title: The Boy Who Changed
summary: Min-Jae confronts Ha-Jun behind the old auditorium with saved security footage. Choosing loyalty over fear, Min-Jae vows to keep the secret. As the Subterranean Quest countdown ticks away, Ha-Jun breaks open the condemned 1920s cellar doors and descends into the ancient demonic chamber below.

panels.action: Wide shot of the condemned Victorian auditorium behind the sports fields; red brick walls covered in overgrown wild ivy and rusted rain gutters.
Min-Jae stands in the shadow of the brick wall, nervously kicking loose gravel with his scuffed sneakers, holding his phone tightly.

dialogue.speaker: min_jae
dialogue.text: Kya wo aayega...?

panels.action: Ha-Jun rounds the brick corner with his hands in his uniform pockets, footsteps steady and silent on the overgrown path.
Min-Jae looks up sharply: 'Tum aa gaye.' / Ha-Jun: 'Tumne note bheja tha. Kya baat karni hai?'

dialogue.speaker: min_jae
dialogue.text: Tum sach mein aa gaye.

panels.action: Min-Jae's hands shake slightly as he taps his smartphone screen: 'Bureau ke aane se pehle maine security backup copy kar liya tha.'

dialogue.speaker: min_jae
dialogue.text: Maine security footage save kar liya tha, Ha-Jun.

panels.action: Close-up on phone screen: A grainy, terrifying video of Ha-Jun leaping from the library window and materializing the glowing purple gauntlet in mid-air.
Min-Jae looks directly into Ha-Jun's eyes: 'Tum teesri manzil se kood gaye aur ek kharoch tak nahi aayi. Aur tumhara haath... wo insaani nahi tha.'

dialogue.speaker: min_jae
dialogue.text: Wo haath... insaani nahi tha.

panels.action: Dead autumn leaves swirl around their feet in the cold wind; a heavy, solemn silence falls between the two students.
Kuro's telepathic hiss from Ha-Jun's shadow: 'Iski memory wipe kar do. Ek blood hex iske dimaag se kal ki saari yaadein mita dega.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Iski memory mita do! Khatra mat lo!

panels.action: Ha-Jun firmly closes his eyes in internal refusal: 'Nahi, Kuro. Jab sab mujhe maarte the, tab yahi akela tha jo meri chot par patti lagata tha.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Min-Jae mera dost hai. Main use nuksan nahi pahunchaunga.

panels.action: Ha-Jun steps forward, tone deep and solemn: 'Min-Jae... agar sach jaan gaye, toh tumhari aam zindagi khatam ho jayegi.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Sach jaan kar tumhari aam zindagi khatam ho sakti hai.

panels.action: Min-Jae doesn't flinch: 'Teen saal se main buzdil ban kar dekhta raha. Kal tumne ek monster se meri jaan bachai. Tum chahe jo bhi ho... main tumhara dost hoon.'

dialogue.speaker: min_jae
dialogue.text: Tum chahe jo bhi ho... main tumhara dost hoon.

panels.action: Ha-Jun's guarded expression melts; a rare, genuine warm smile appears on his face for the first time in seven years.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Main akela nahi hoon...

panels.action: Ha-Jun raises his right hand; tiny, harmless violet sparks of mana dance playfully across his fingertips like fireflies.
Min-Jae's glasses reflect the glowing purple sparks in childlike wonder: 'Yeh... yeh kya hai?!'

dialogue.speaker: min_jae
dialogue.text: Yeh jaadu hai kya...?!

panels.action: Ha-Jun: 'Mere bade bhai Tae-Jun... unka khoon mere andar jaag utha hai. Aur wo abhi bhi zinda hain.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Bhaiya ka khoon jaag gaya hai. Wo zinda hain, Min-Jae.

panels.action: A sharp holographic chime rings in Ha-Jun's vision: [TIME REMAINING: 01:45:00] flashing neon-yellow.
Ha-Jun winces, clutching his chest as his sovereign core sends a burning pulse through his collarbone.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Waqt bohot kam bacha hai...!

panels.action: Ha-Jun points toward two angled, rusted iron cellar storm doors embedded in the stone foundation of the auditorium.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Wahan neeche... koi cheez mere khoon ko bula rahi hai.

panels.action: Thick black frost coats the massive industrial chain and padlock binding the cellar doors, cold demonic vapor seeping out.
Min-Jae inspects the doors: 'Yeh 1920s ka basement lab tha. Pachaas saal pehle ek ajeeb hadse ke baad isse permanently seal kar diya gaya tha!'

dialogue.speaker: min_jae
dialogue.text: Pachaas saal se yeh band hai! Kehte hain yahan koi nahi bacha tha!

panels.action: Ha-Jun grips the heavy hardened steel padlock; with a single casual twist of his bare wrist, the thick shackle shears in half like plastic.
Min-Jae stares at the severed padlock shackle with wide eyes: 'Okay... main tumse kabhi panja nahi ladaunga.'

dialogue.speaker: min_jae
dialogue.text: Okay... panja ladane ka plan cancel.

panels.action: Ha-Jun pulls both heavy iron doors upward with a grinding metallic groan, breaking decades of rusted seal.
A freezing blast of ancient air, purple miasma, and glowing violet dust particles rushes out of the dark opening into their faces.
Looking down: An ancient stone spiral staircase winds down endlessly into deep, shadowy subterranean chambers carved into bedrock.

dialogue.text: University ke neeche... ek sadiyon purana shaitan ka mandir tha.

panels.action: Kuro solidifies on Ha-Jun's shoulder, eyes ablaze: 'Yeh jagah university banne se hazaron saal pehle se yahan maujood hai.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Yeh jagah university se bhi hazaron saal purani hai.

panels.action: Ha-Jun turns to Min-Jae: 'Tum upar darwaze par nazar rakho. Agar Bureau ke Hunter aayein, toh turant bhaag jana.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Upar dhyan rakhna. Koi aaye toh turant bhaagna.

panels.action: Min-Jae picks up a heavy rusted iron pipe from the ground, nodding resolutely: 'Main yahin hoon. Zinda wapas aana.'

dialogue.speaker: min_jae
dialogue.text: Main nazar rakhunga. Zinda wapas aana, Ha-Jun.

panels.shot: first step into the subterranean abyss cliffhanger
panels.action: Ha-Jun takes his first step down into the pitch-black stone staircase; his irises ignite with radiant, commanding violet demonic fire: 'Chalo.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Chalo, Kuro. Asli khel ab shuru hota hai.
